title: Rory and the Starlight Glade
verses:
The moon rose in silence above the dark trees,
And carried a song on the cool night-time breeze.
Sweet Psittaco chirped from his nest in the leaves,
While shadows danced soft on the moss-covered eaves.

Big Rory walked slow through the sleepy green glade,
And smiled at the path that the moonlight had made.
Kind Tilly stepped close with a warm, gentle sigh,
To watch all the fireflies drift in the sky.

Dear Benny sank down on the soft, clover bed,
And tucked in his tail as he rested his head.
Then Ricky curled up near a moss-covered boulder,
His chin on his paw as the night air grew colder.

Up high in a pine tree, sweet Nia swooped round,
Then landed so lightly, without any sound.
And tiny Psittaco snuggled in tight,
Beneath her warm wing for a peaceful goodnight.

Green Rory let out a soft yawn in the dark,
As fireflies glowed with a tiny gold spark.
Calm Tilly leaned near him to keep him so warm,
Safe wrapped in the peace of a night free from storm.

The silver stars shone on the dinosaurs deep,
And rocked all the friends in a blanket of sleep.
So close your eyes now as the quiet night gleams,
And drift far away into magical dreams.
